name: BMW M135i F20/F21 (N55 3.0 turbo, 2012–2016)
source: BMW Condition Based Service intervals for N55, plus specialist guidance (jxlperformance.co.uk). BMW's CBS on the car overrides this if shorter.

items.name: Engine oil & filter
items.notes: BMW LL-01 5W-30. BMW allows ~10k/12 mo. Your 5k rule suits a turbo direct-injection engine.

items.name: Service inspection (brakes, tyres, suspension, leaks: oil filter housing and rocker cover gaskets)
items.notes: The N55 electric water pump and thermostat often fail around 60–80k mi. Replace on first warning.

items.name: Spark plugs
items.notes: BMW figure. Specialists do 30–40k on N55, sooner if remapped.

items.name: Brake fluid
items.notes: BMW: after 3 years, then every 2. Every 2 is simpler.

items.name: Coolant
items.notes: BMW lists lifetime fill. Specialists recommend 4 years / 60k.

items.name: ZF 8HP automatic gearbox fluid & sump/filter
items.notes: BMW says lifetime fill. ZF recommends 8–10 years / 60–75k mi. Many specialists do 50k.

items.name: Rear differential oil
items.notes: Sooner with a limited-slip diff or track use.
